# Leaflet 1.9.4

Pinned upstream release, vendored for lazy-loaded static maps without a runtime CDN dependency.

- JS: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
- CSS: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
- License: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/v1.9.4/LICENSE

License text is bundled in LICENSE. The map uses custom numbered markers, so the default marker images are not needed. Map tiles load directly in the visitor's browser only when map view is selected. Follow the OpenStreetMap tile usage policy; no bulk fetch, offline prefetch or tile scraping.
